name: Program/Project Grants
summary: Once-a-year competitive grants to nonprofits for conservation, restoration and stewardship projects in Montana and the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem.

geography.label: Montana and the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem

amount.note: No more than 50% of the total project budget, whichever is less

reporting: Grantees send an interim or final report on progress and on how the funds were spent.

status.quote: The 2027 Grant application cycle will be open from Jan 11 - Feb 19, 2027.

opens.quote: The 2027 Grant application cycle will be open from Jan 11 - Feb 19, 2027.

deadline.quote: The 2027 Grant application cycle will be open from Jan 11 - Feb 19, 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Grants from the Cinnabar Foundation are available to nonprofit 501(c)(3) charitable organizations, schools or university programs engaged in conservation within Montana and the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem.

geography.quote: The Cinnabar Foundation supports organizations that effectively conserve, preserve and restore the natural environment in Montana and the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem.

access.quote: Only online applications will be accepted.

window.quote: The Cinnabar Foundation accepts grant applications once per year.

amount.quote: grant amounts will range from $2,500 - $15,000, and not exceed 50% of the total project budget, whichever is less

co_finance_required.quote: Organizations are not required to match Cinnabar funding.

reporting.quote: must submit an interim / final report describing the progress made toward achieving the purposes outlined in the applicant's grant application and detailing expenditures made from the granted funds
